issues.issue: What documents must the appeal book contain, including whether a basket clause referring to all DES-3-03 exhibits is added?
issues.applicant_position: Appeal book should be limited to documents required to resolve the issues, those filed at trial and those relevant; basket clause goes too far.
issues.respondent_position: Charkaoui wants far wider contents (all correspondence, judgments, DES-3-03 exhibits, basket clause); Ministers approved the appellants' drafts.
issues.result_quote: Consequently, the appeal book shall be comprised of the exhibits listed in Schedule A of the proposed order contained at Tab 4 of the appellants’ motion record.
